scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy: 5% Additional Capital Investment Subsidy to Karaikal Region
other_conditions: The applicant must have an industrial unit located in the Karaikal Region of Puducherry.
The applicant must be engaged in a priority industry announced by the Government and set up in Karaikal.
benefits_summary: Provides an extra 5% incentive on existing subsidy schemes for units in Karaikal, with caps ranging from ₹25 lakhs to ₹40 lakhs depending on sector and entrepreneur category.
